thread:
Lenka: Quick ping: PR #4890 adds the SDK migration note for the routing policy change. We need a docs review and merge before the v0.9.2 docs freeze (Thu 11:59pm PT). Preview failing because of an external link timeout.

Marcus: I'll review the prose tonight. Is this doc supposed to land only in v0.9 or both versioned/unversioned?

Lenka: Both. Add frontmatter `version: v0.9` and leave the unversioned copy to show the migration example. Also call out the feature flag `routing.region_priority_v1` in the warning box.

Nia: I noticed the Python SDK snippet still uses `client.send_request(...)`. The runtime team wants us to show the higher-level `client.set_route(...)` helper. Small change but important for parity with the examples in the SDK repo.

Marcus: I can swap that snippet. Any other blockers?

Lenka: Link-check points to a 504 on the internal rules page `/ops/traffic-routing`. Might be transient but we should replace the anchor link to `/ops/traffic-routing#policy-examples` to be more specific.

docs-ci-bot: Link-check failed: 504 to docs-internal (transient). You can re-run preview with `gh workflow run docs-preview.yml -f pr=4890`.

Marcus: I'll make the SDK + link changes and push a patch to the branch. Tagging @Nia for snippet sanity check.

Nia: I'll verify after you push. Also please add a short changelog line under "Migration notes" so support can triage.

Lenka: Release note reminder: we need this merged by 6pm PT Thu to allow staging QA. If it's later it will miss the RC. @release-captain can confirm.

release-captain: Confirmed: target merge by 6pm PT Thu. Anything after 11:59pm PT goes to the next minor. If CI is flaky, escalate here by 5pm and we'll consider a manual hold.

Marcus: Patch pushed. I updated the snippet to `client.set_route(region='us-west', policy='latency')`, fixed the internal anchor, added `version: v0.9` frontmatter, and added a one-line changelog.

docs-ci-bot: Preview started for PR 4890. Link-check in progress...

Lenka: Thanks. When preview finishes, please paste the preview URL here so QA can pick it up.

docs-ci-bot: Preview succeeded. Link-check passed on second run. Preview URL: https://docs-preview.internal.redwood/4890

Nia: Verified the Python snippet runs with the SDK example harness. Looks good.

Marcus: Ready for review. @Lenka, can you give a quick content pass?

Lenka: Quick pass done. Approved.

Marcus: Merging now.

docs-ci-bot: PR merged. Deployment to staging will happen in ~5m.

release-captain: Included in v0.9.2 RC. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :shipit:
